fruits.description: EVERY fruit instance visible in the image, ripe or not, including partially occluded ones.

bbox.description: Bounding box [x1, y1, x2, y2] of the whole fruit, including the parts hidden behind leaves or other fruit. Fruit body only: exclude the calyx and stem when they sit apart from the fruit; a calyx lying flat on the fruit is inside.

polygon.description: Ordered outline of the fruit's VISIBLE surface as [x, y] pixel vertices, walked once around the boundary (clockwise or counter-clockwise, start anywhere). Follow occluder edges where the fruit is hidden - do not extrapolate the hidden shape. 8-20 vertices for a typical fruit, 32 at most; simple closed outline, no repeated closing vertex.

redness_pct.description: Continuous estimate, 0-100, of how much of the fruit's VISIBLE surface shows its RIPE colour. No categories: 0 = fully immature colour (green), 50 = about half the visible surface is ripe-coloured, 100 = fully ripe-coloured everywhere. Use intermediate values freely.

occlusion_pct.description: Continuous estimate, 0-100, of how much of the fruit is hidden behind leaves, stems or other fruit. 0 = fully visible, 50 = about half hidden, 100 = only a sliver shows. Use intermediate values freely.

calyx_visible.description: True if the calyx (sepal ring at the fruit's stem end) is visible; false when the fruit type has none or it is not visible.

peduncle_visible.description: True if the peduncle (stem) is visible where it meets the fruit; false when the fruit type has none or it is not visible.

graspable.description: True if this fruit could be picked right now from what is visible.

confidence_pct.description: How confident you are that this really is a fruit instance of the asked kind.

description.description: Optional short free-text description of this fruit - its colour and colour pattern, what is occluding it and where, size, position on the plant, or anything else useful. One or two sentences.
